Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned Aga for the State and perused the records.

2.  This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants with the prayer to quash summoning order dated 08.12.2021 as well as entire proceedings of Complaint Case No. 2122 of 2020 (Salma Bano Vs. Jafar), under Sections 323, 498A, 504 and 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that opposite party no.2 is the wife of applicant no.1 and applicant nos. 2 & 3 are her parents-in-law.

He has further submitted that on account of matrimonial discord, present criminal case has been instituted against the applicants by opposite party no.2.
4.This Court vide its order dated 25.01.2023 had directed the parties to appear before the Allahabad High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre in order to explore possibility of settlement of the dispute between the parties through mediation.
5.Pursuant to the said order dated 25.01.2023, the parties appeared before theAllahabad High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre and with the help of the mediators, the dispute between the parties has been settled and a settlement agreement dated 30.05.2023 has been drawn between them, a copy of which has been filed today in Court and shall form part of the record.

entities.text: Allahabad High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that in view of the said compromise and in order to maintain harmonious and cordial relations between the parties, entire proceedings against the applicants be quashed.
7. Learned AGA could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

8. This Court is not unmindful of the judgements of the Apex Court in the cases of:-
(i). B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another (2003) 4 SCC 675.
(ii). Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation [2008) 9 SCC 677].
